title: Workwell & Social Prescribing Platform
description:
A digital community coordination, social prescribing, and work and health platform designed to support health, care, local authority, and voluntary, community and social enterprise (VCSE) organisations across Leicester, Leicestershire and Rutland.
The platform enables organisations to connect individuals with appropriate community, voluntary, statutory, NHS, and work and health support, while coordinating referrals, managing personalised pathways, and monitoring outcomes.
